effects.printed_clause: Declare 1 card name; roll a six-sided die, then excavate cards from the top of your deck equal to the result, then add 1 excavated card with the declared name to your hand.
effects.lua_implementation: The target announces and stores a card code. Resolution rolls one die, reveals up to that many available Deck cards, selects one matching card if present, attempts to add it, and shuffles the Deck.

official_references.matched_structure: Announces and stores a card code for use during resolution.
Calls Duel.TossDice during the resolving operation.

effects.printed_clause: If you did not add any card by this effect, you lose 2000 LP.
effects.lua_implementation: Resolution initializes added=false and changes it only when Duel.SendtoHand succeeds; it subtracts 2000 LP whenever no card was actually added, including a failed add despite an excavated name match.

official_references.matched_structure: Applies the result-dependent consequence during effect resolution after the die roll.

effects.issue: Fixed: the LP-loss branch now depends on successful addition rather than merely finding a matching excavated card.
